title: Data-Driven Recruiting: How Lattice Scales Hiring with Analytics and Drives Efficiency
summary: How Lattice’s lean recruiting coordination team uses ModernLoop scheduling and reporting to manage high recruiting volume.
body_markdown:
Lattice, a leading provider of people management and HR solutions, has built a strong reputation for helping companies create engaged and high-performing teams. As Lattice scaled, its recruiting team faced increasing hiring demands while maintaining a lean structure. With just one recruiting coordinator supporting five recruiters, Lattice’s team, lead by Nicole Hirsch, needed a way to streamline scheduling, improve efficiency, and ensure an exceptional candidate experience.


Watch the webinar where Nicole shares her tips on how to maintain efficiency in recruiting[here.](https://modernloop.zoom.us/rec/share/xVbTD7-kIa9i5jewolFZw4ePzqDyEJfInEoC09sdcOt39VI11bcAKp9jWF_K3_Fp.vUJJ2wS2W5wyfaPi?startTime=1738177339000)
